description: This file defines the UserSelection class for Drupal, providing custom access control and query building for user entity references within the Drupal CMS. It includes methods for configuration, entity query alteration, and user creation/validation.

classes.name: UserSelection
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that manages user entity reference selection with custom access control and filtering options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the UserSelection object with dependencies including database connection, entity managers, and current user.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default configuration options for the selection, including filtering and anonymous user inclusion.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the user selection widget, including filter options and role restrictions.

methods.name: buildEntityQuery
methods.description: Constructs the entity query with filters based on configuration, such as role and anonymous user inclusion.

methods.name: createNewEntity
methods.description: Creates a new user entity, activating it if the current user lacks permission to administer users.

methods.name: validateReferenceableNewEntities
methods.description: Validates new user entities against role and status filters before referencing.

methods.name: entityQueryAlter
methods.description: Alters the entity query to include or exclude anonymous users based on configuration and permissions.
